violations: Table 7 (p.7): Nitrate as N over the MCL. Result was 11 mg/L, MCL is 10 mg/L; date 9/17/25. Actions taken: first and second quarter results for 2026 were below the MCL. Nitrate health-effects language included.

Level 1 Assessment (p.8): During the past year we were required to conduct one Level 1 assessment, completed on June 20, 2025. Positive coliform results on 5/21/25 triggered the Level 1 Assessment. The well was chlorinated and repeat samples have all been absent for coliform and E. coli.
